title: SAML 2.0 guided metadata exchange: fingerprint checks + live validation preview
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build an interactive, opinionated SAML 2.0 metadata exchange flow that helps admins safely onboard an Identity Provider by fetching or uploading metadata, verifying certificate fingerprints and chains, running live Assertion Consumer Service (ACS) and SingleSignOnService validation checks, and emitting structured audit events for every step.
background: Current SAML onboarding in Redwood Console requires manual copy/paste of XML and sparse validation. Customers repeatedly hit issues caused by stale metadata, mismatched certs, and implicit trust decisions. We need a safer, observable flow that reduces manual mistakes and surfaces validation failures with remediation guidance.
goals: Provide a guided UI flow that accepts metadata URL or file upload and shows a live validation preview
Automatically compute and display SHA256 fingerprint(s) for signing certificates and allow admin-approved overrides with explicit justification
Validate XML against SAML 2.0 metadata schema and check certificate chain (self-signed vs CA-signed) with configurable policy
Emit audit log events for fetch, parse, validation results, and final acceptance/rejection with actor and reason
Add RBAC control that gates who can accept metadata changes (admin role only) and record that in the audit event
non_goals: Full IdP provisioning via SCIM or automatic user-sync (out of scope)
Automatic rotation of IdP signing keys on vendor side (we will only surface key rotation and allow manual acceptance)
Replace existing SSO plumbing—this is an onboarding UX / validation surface and audit trail enhancement
technical_notes: Accept both metadata URL (http/https) and raw XML upload; fetches from URL must follow egress proxy and respect VPC allowlists
Run XML validation using xmlschema library and a vetted SAML 2.0 metadata XSD bundle; capture validation errors as structured strings
Extract KeyDescriptor certificates, compute SHA256 fingerprints and present both raw cert PEM and fingerprint to admin
Perform basic cert chain validation using embedded roots plus optional customer CA bundle (configurable per org)
Implement a lightweight live check: simulate SP metadata exchange by sending an HTTP HEAD to ACS and querying SingleSignOnService endpoints with GET/POST bindings and report reachable status
Store candidate metadata in an immutable staging record until an admin accepts; acceptance writes final metadata and triggers audit event
tradeoffs: Strict chain validation will reduce broken integrations but may increase support burden for customers using self-signed certs; we will provide an explicit override with recorded justification
Performing live endpoint checks improves confidence but can introduce delays and transient false negatives (network flakiness); keep these checks async with realtime feedback in UI
Allowing metadata URL fetch improves convenience but introduces SSRF risk—limit to known ports, enforce allowlist or proxy, and scan for external redirects
milestones: Spec + API contract for metadata staging and audit events (done)
Backend: metadata fetch + XML validate + fingerprint extraction (in progress)
Frontend: guided flow with live validation preview and override UX (next)
RBAC: admin-only accept path + permissions tests (next)
QA and security review, rollout behind feature flag, telemetry validation (final)
acceptance_criteria: Given a metadata URL or XML upload, system computes certificate SHA256 fingerprint and displays it in UI
XML metadata is validated against SAML XSD and any validation errors are surfaced as human-readable messages
Live checks attempt ACS/SSO endpoint reachability and show pass/fail; failures do not auto-block acceptance if admin explicitly overrides
Audit events are emitted for: metadata_fetch_attempt, metadata_parse_result, metadata_validation_result, metadata_accepted, metadata_rejected; events include actor, timestamp, org_id, and reason
Only principals with role 'org.admin' can perform accept action; other users can only propose or preview
Feature flag exists to toggle guided exchange per org; rollout plan documented
testing_plan: Unit tests for XML validation error messages and fingerprint calculation
Integration test: simulate common IdP metadata (Okta, ADFS, Auth0) and ensure validation passes and fingerprints match
Network test: ensure metadata URL fetch respects VPC egress allowlist and proxy headers
Security test: SSRF scan and fuzz metadata URL handlers, ensure timeouts and redirect limits enforced
End-to-end QA: onboarding flow with both upload and URL, RBAC checks using test orgs, audit log verification in observability console
rollout_plan: Feature flag release to 10% of orgs for 1 week
If failure_rate > 3% for 72h, rollback flag and notify security/commops
Gradually increase to 100% after remediation and sign-off
